scope: SPC System Health and Tech Stack read/retry/response ownership
corrections: Health refresh failure explicitly marks the last successful check stale; later cache hits retain that disclosure until a new check succeeds. The page shows UNKNOWN rather than presenting old green checks as current.

Health checks have a bounded15-second server deadline and reject unverified table counts instead of manufacturing zero. Fresh/cached/stale attempt metadata uses one captured start timestamp for every check.

Both operational pages validate responses, retain only previously loaded data on transient failure, provide refresh/retry, clear private data on401/403 or account/access change, and fence ignored-abort fetch and body completions. Client deadlines are30seconds.

SPC Tech Stack uses canonical connection identifiers and clearly labels masked environment values as presence only, not credential validation. Both API success and error responses are private/no-store.
Operational text and database identifiers wrap on narrow screens; the existing service table remains horizontally scrollable with its final column reachable.
Historical candidates retain their own identity keys. Different known IMOs cannot match through a shared vessel name; exact IMO priority and the existing missing-IMO name fallback are preserved.

Lost Record View/Edit authorizes cancelled-record reads without an unrelated New Enquiry permission. That scope accepts only unique scope/status/limit parameters and cannot expand to open/all feeds, bootstrap or incremental cursors. Own and shared Speed Board permissions/filters are unchanged.

regressions.operationalApi: Actual route/cache/private response helpers and actual Supabase SDK, synthetic clock/actor/HEAD transport. Includes advancing clock, cached failure disclosure, auth-before-cache, invalid counts, coalescing and ignored-abort server deadline.
regressions.operationalBrowser: Actual pages, SPC shell and global CSS. Chromium/WebKit,320/390/1440, light/dark OS preferences, View/Edit/none/signed-out, malformed/error/access responses, actor replacement, deferred JSON, ignored-abort timeout, table scrolling and long identifiers. Only the shipped30-second deadline is clock-scaled in the isolated fixture.
regressions.historicalApi: Actual Today route/library/identity predicate, synthetic identity/transport. Conflicting known IMOs in both previous fixtures and lost records, rename/legacy fallback, strictly earlier history, Hong Kong day boundaries and no internal identity metadata leakage.
regressions.listPermissionApi: Actual enquiries GET/scope/normalizer/mapper with synthetic auth and read transport; separate Lost/own/shared/legacy-shared/none/unsigned boundaries and13 unsupported records shapes.
regressions.ci: Permanent response/API and operational-browser checks added without removing existing calendar/session, audit or security checks. Production dependencies must pass; only the already-standing development-only braces advisory may remain.

unchanged: No migration, dependency, credential, actual account permission, provider, email, scheduled job, federation contract or OIDC/synchronization implementation change.
No live enquiry, fixture, lost record or other business-data write. No personal browser tab was navigated or modified.
stillOpen: Lost Record/Daily Briefing still have250-row lists and global1000-row historical cutoffs; complete pagination and targeted historical reads need a separate tested implementation.
Daily Briefing and Lost Record list/draft refresh ownership and false-empty states remain a separate repair scope.

Canonical account/group atomic changes and SPC user metadata changes remain held separately for writer drain/rollout compatibility; this ordinary read-page release does not waive those safeguards or establish a cross-project federation mutex.

Signed-in behavior is exercised with isolated synthetic identities and real components/routes. This does not certify a physical iPhone/Safari or a signed-in production mutation. Static service descriptions are repository descriptions, not proof of every external integration's current health.
The broad sitewide-debug goal is not complete. This record describes only this bounded batch; immutable release and live-verification receipts are maintained separately.
